acceptances.given: Canonical semantic compilation and exact-cover validation are performed.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports reciprocal links for every Atomic Obligation across assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence.

acceptances.given: A replay result is produced or recorded.

oracle.expected: The replay result contains or references a complete Current Snapshot sufficient to identify all replay-relevant current state.
forbidden: Replay result is emitted without a complete Current Snapshot binding.
Replay result is bound to a partial or incomplete snapshot.
oracle.observable: The replay result includes a complete snapshot identity manifest.

acceptances.then: The replay result is bound to a complete Current Snapshot.
acceptances.when: A replay result is produced or recorded.

acceptances.given: FR-9 reconciliation is performed against the current Consumer Manifest and repository callers.

oracle.expected: Both manifest-to-caller and caller-to-manifest checks cover all identified VDD callers.
forbidden: Only one direction of reconciliation is performed.
VDD callers are omitted from reconciliation.
oracle.observable: The reconciliation artifact contains both directional caller coverage.

acceptances.then: The Consumer Manifest and VDD repository callers are reconciled in both directions.

acceptances.given: A seed artifact is produced or evaluated.

oracle.expected: The seed artifact exposes a present and empty machine-verifiable authorization set.
forbidden: A seed artifact exposes a non-empty authorization set.
A seed artifact omits a machine-verifiable authorization set.
oracle.observable: The artifact's parsed authorization set equals an empty array.

acceptances.then: The seed artifact exposes an empty machine-verifiable authorization set.
acceptances.when: A seed artifact is produced or evaluated.

acceptances.given: A configured execution budget is exhausted.

oracle.expected: The run has an unsuccessful terminal result.
forbidden: Budget exhaustion is classified as successful.
Budget exhaustion is treated as an indeterminate success or omitted outcome.
oracle.observable: The terminal result records failure after time or output budget exhaustion.

acceptances.then: The budget-exhausted execution has an unsuccessful terminal result.
acceptances.when: A configured execution budget is exhausted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exercise target evaluation with an escaping target and require fail-closed rejection.
Exercise target evaluation with a missing target and require fail-closed rejection.
Run effective-target inspection and fail if evidence does not show an actual effective read.
Run independent identity verification and fail if identity is inferred or unverified.
Run the exact S7 pytest selector and fail when the real production entry point is not exercised.
Run the exact S28 pytest selector and fail when behavior_routing.py is bypassed.
Run the exact S41 pytest selector and fail when either declared production entry point is bypassed.
Run the exact S21 pytest selector and fail when either declared production entry point is bypassed.
Run exact-cover validation with one missing reciprocal artifact link and require failure.
Produce a replay result with an incomplete snapshot and require stale or failed output.
Remove a VDD caller from one reconciliation direction and require closure failure.
Evaluate a seed artifact with a non-empty or missing authorizes field and require rejection.
Exhaust the configured execution budget and require an unsuccessful terminal result.
